items.title: Q-081 z_goal/z_harm_a reach pre-flight SCAN: does the landmark-manipulation lever reach the REFRAMED (z_world, z_goal) pair, falling back to (z_world, z_harm_a)?
items.note:
Follow-on of the 2026-08-01 /claim-synthesis Q-081 measured-pair reframe (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_Q-081_2026-08-01.md, session elastic-merkle-e0cca8, chip chip-20260801-q081-zgoal-probe), itself the direct successor of V3-EXQ-849 (same discipline: 824/824a/838/849 confirmed ZERO reach from four manipulation families to the now-RETIRED (z_world, operating_mode) pair; the claim-synthesis traced why -- operating_mode's precursor set has no wired edge from z_world/landmark structure at all -- and found two genuinely different, already-coded, single-hop paths from the SAME landmark-manipulation lever into cross-stream targets: z_goal (E1 gate_stream, agent.py ~4895, gated on goal.e1_goal_conditioned + goal_state.is_active()) and z_harm_a (E2_harm_a gate_stream, agent.py ~8332, gated on agent.e2_harm_a configured). Per the same discipline, this is a cheap pre-flight reach probe for the new pair(s) BEFORE any full multi-seed recording run.

SUBSTRATE (built this session): experiments/_lib/q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py -- a generalisation of q081_pair_reach_check.py (Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC) parametrised by target stream ('z_goal' or 'z_harm_a'), reusing that module's pure comparator (pair_specific_reach_report) and matched-arm/RNG-reset discipline verbatim, but reading the raw+gated per-dimension tensor value of the target stream (via VsRolloutGate._gate_value, its pure non-mutating comparison, rather than the mutating public gate_stream()/gate() wrappers) instead of the salience precursor dict. Adds a SECOND non-degeneracy guard beyond the inherited boundary-event one: the target stream's own activation precondition must clear on at least one tick, or a 'no reach' verdict from an all-None trace would be vacuous.

MANUAL VALIDATION AT AUTHORING TIME (2026-08-01, this session -- see the driver script's own module docstring for full figures): z_goal's activation precondition turned out to be the HARD-to-clear one -- the OPPOSITE of the claim-synthesis doc's prediction that z_goal would have lower precondition surface than z_harm_a. A cheap single-agent scan (no scrambler/second arm) across seeds 0-4 at up to 30 episodes x 300 steps found z_goal activates within a ~600-1200 cumulative-tick budget at seeds 2/3/4, but needs MANY episode restarts (short per-episode survival under this untrained agent's own policy dominates, not a longer per-episode step cap) -- hence this script's ZGOAL_N_EPISODES=30/STEPS_PER_EPISODE=300, larger than V3-EXQ-849's 3x400 budget for the always-populated salience precursor. z_harm_a, by contrast, activates from tick 1 onward every tick once configured (use_e2_harm_a=True, set by this module for the z_harm_a target only, plus the already-profile-default use_affective_harm_stream=True) -- confirmed non-degenerate at n_episodes=1/steps=150/seed=2 (n_active_ticks=150/150). At that same cheap setting, has_pair_specific_reach was False for all three manipulation levers tried manually (iei_permute, jitter, suppress) -- carried forward as context, not assumed; this script's own multi-seed leg is what adjudicates it.

DESIGN: z_goal leg ALWAYS runs first (5 seeds x 2 levers [iei_permute known, jitter untried, matching V3-EXQ-849's own lever choice] x N_EPISODES=30/steps=300 = 10 cells). If it finds >=1 non-degenerate cell with reach: PASS, H1 for z_goal live, z_harm_a leg SKIPPED (not needed). If z_goal finds zero reach (whether genuinely tested-and-null, or fully degenerate/inactive): falls back to the z_harm_a leg (5 seeds x 2 levers x N_EPISODES=3/steps=200 = 10 cells, cheap given immediate activation). Final verdict cascades: z_goal reach found > z_harm_a fallback reach found > both genuinely null (informative, PASS, recommend escalating past a config-lever probe per the claim-synthesis doc's own note) > both fully degenerate (FAIL, substrate_not_ready_requeue, re-queue with a larger budget). This probe does NOT adjudicate Q-081 Outcome A vs B and does NOT itself queue any substrate change -- per the claim-synthesis doc, a direct write-path substrate build (if both targets come back genuinely zero-reach) is a governance decision, out of scope for /queue-experiment.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (precursor-level has_pair_specific_reach for z_goal and, conditionally, z_harm_a) has never been computed by any prior run -- 824/824a/838/849 all tested the now-retired (z_world, operating_mode) pair exclusively; q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py did not exist before this session. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.

Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): both gate_stream call sites, VsRolloutGate._gate_value, GoalState.is_active()/update()/StepHarness's canonical update_z_goal wiring, and E2HarmAForward's use_e2_harm_a construction path all re-read directly from current ree_core source this session (agent.py, vs_rollout_gate.py, goal.py, _harness.py, config.py). No new build needed -- this is a diagnostic reach-scan over already-coded, already-config-reachable paths.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): does not fire -- Q-081's chain (824/824a/838, autopsy-confirmed measurement_test_design_defect) plus 849 (diagnostic PASS, non_contributory) is entirely the measurement_test_design_defect / diagnostic-reach-scan category, not substrate_ceiling; this run also targets a DIFFERENT measured pair (z_goal/z_harm_a, not operating_mode), so even a same-category count would not be a same-mechanism re-test.

DV-symmetry (604c): not applicable -- this is a diagnostic reach probe over a boolean precursor-divergence detector (per-dimension float diff, tol=0.0), not an arm scored against a DV symmetry class.

Code review (Step 3.5): claim_ids=['Q-081'] (only claim this run's implementation tests); EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE='diagnostic' correct (reach-scan, not a claim-hypothesis test); ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT declared and justified by this session's own manual single-agent + full-probe validation (see script docstring); preconditions[]/criteria_non_degenerate/load_bearing criterion all present per the diagnostic adjudication gate (combined 'at_least_one_target_has_a_non_degenerate_cell' is the load-bearing precondition; per-target non-degeneracy is informational, correctly not gating alone since the fallback cascade means one target's degeneracy does not invalidate the other's reading); substrate API re-verified live (not copied from 849 unchecked -- new call sites: GoalState, E2HarmAForward, VsRolloutGate._gate_value); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core via config/seeds/script_path/started_at, matching 849's own pattern) verified; not multi-arm in the arm_fingerprint sense (results recorded under zgoal_leg/zharm_a_leg, not arm_results -- no training, no reuse-eligible baseline arm to mint), confirmed by validate_experiments.py's own 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog finding.

validate_experiments.py --strict --paths experiments/v3_exq_865_q081_zgoal_reach_preflight_scan.py: OK, 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind. Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed x 2 levers x both legs at n_episodes=1/steps=20 toy scale): pipeline runs end to end, z_goal leg correctly falls back to z_harm_a leg (z_goal degenerate at toy scale as expected), self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at this toy scale (informative, not a crash -- matches 849's own toy-scale dry-run self-route). tests/contracts/test_q081_pair_reach_check_stream.py (21, new this session, incl. 2 live-substrate smoke tests pinning the real measured boundary-event/activation figures cited above) + tests/contracts/test_q081_pair_reach_check.py (15, pre-existing, unmodified) all pass locally.

items.title: MECH-180 redesign: write-count-decoupled sws_slot_diversity DV (supersedes V3-EXQ-845)
items.note:
Redesign of V3-EXQ-845's spindle-density DV, per user-confirmed autopsy routing (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-845_2026-08-01.md: "Mixed + redesign the DV"). 845 was the FIRST ecological end-to-end test of MECH-180's two links (novelty->MEL, MEL->consolidation) run together; readiness fully met, and 2/3 predicted DVs (cumulative_sws_writes, cumulative_rem_rollouts) showed clean monotone dose-response in 2/3 seeds and ON>OFF in 3/3 seeds -- genuine partial support, the first positive end-to-end signal this claim has produced. The third DV (mean_sws_slot_diversity, 'spindle density') inverted in all 3 seeds and alone failed 845's blanket C2 AND-gate, collapsing the whole run to non_contributory despite the other two DVs being clean and positive. Autopsy-confirmed root cause: sws_slot_diversity was computed as mean pairwise cosine distance across the WHOLE 16-slot, EMA-blended, persistent ContextMemory bank (ree_core/agent.py ~10148-10161; ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py 39/73-80) -- higher MEL drives more writes into the SAME fixed-capacity store, mechanically shrinking whole-bank diversity regardless of real content-differentiation quality; the manipulated variable (write count) confounds the DV. recommended_epistemic_category = measurement_test_design_defect (NOT substrate_ceiling) -- the substrate demonstrably sustains the predicted coupling (2/3 DVs prove it).

THE FIX (this run): restricts the diversity readout to ONLY the ContextMemory slots actually written during the CURRENT measurement cycle (detected via a before/after snapshot of agent.e1.context_memory.memory bracketing each force_cycle() call), isolating differentiation QUALITY from consolidation VOLUME. This is candidate (2) from the autopsy's two options (restrict to newly-targeted slots), chosen over candidate (1) (normalize by write count) because dividing an already write-count-decreasing whole-bank statistic by write count would COMPOUND the inverse relationship rather than decouple it, whereas the touched-slot restriction is a pure, directly-justified readout change. Requires NO ree_core change: ContextMemory.memory is a plain nn.Parameter already read directly elsewhere in ree_core (e1_deep.py extract_cue_context/shy_normalise), and write() (e1_deep.py:73-80) touches exactly the argmin-scored slot per call via an in-place EMA blend, so a before/after diff exactly recovers the touched-slot set. Re-verified this session (not merely assumed from 845) that no OTHER writer touches ContextMemory.memory during a measurement cycle for this config: sd016_writepath_mode defaults 'off' (unset here, as in 845) so the per-tick waking write hook (agent.py ~4491-4510) is inactive; shy_enabled defaults False (unset here) so enter_sws_mode() does not call e1.shy_normalise (which would decay ALL slots toward their mean and destroy the diff's selectivity); force_cycle()'s replay_sampler/routing_gate/aggregator branch is inert since use_sleep_aggregation_cluster is never set by this driver. Legacy whole-bank statistic retained as a non-gating diagnostic (mean_sws_slot_diversity_wholebank_legacy) for cross-lineage comparability; C1b/C2's spindle-density leg now gates on mean_sws_new_slot_diversity. Everything else (arms, seeds, env, C1a/C1c, R1/R2, INTERPRETATION GRID) is IDENTICAL to 845.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4, this session): checked 845's manifest directly (v3_exq_845_..._20260731T235634Z_v3.json, arm_results[i] keys) -- it records only per-cycle scalar aggregates (per_cycle_diversity = whole-bank stat, per_cycle_sws = write count) and NEVER recorded which ContextMemory slot indices were written nor any raw memory-tensor snapshot at any cycle boundary. The decisive readout for this run (diversity among only this-cycle's touched slots) is therefore NOT recoverable by post-hoc reanalysis of 845 -- proceeds to a new run.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b, this session): grep-count script against REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json for MECH-180 -> count = 3 (V3-EXQ-677/718/718a, all substrate_ceiling/producer-gap class) >= threshold 2. UNCHANGED from 845's own docstring count. Brake was already RELEASED for this lineage in 845 (upstream substrate SD-MEL-PRODUCER VALIDATED); this redesign does not reopen that question, it repairs an instrument bug in the run that already tested the now-built substrate. 845 itself is not in the .json autopsy corpus the counter scans (it is a .md-only autopsy) and its recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling, so per Step 2.5b's per-category rule it would not add to the count even if it were -- this is the 'not braked' diagnostic-DV-repair case, not a same-ceiling re-derive.

Code review (Step 3.5, this session): claim tagging unchanged/re-verified (claim_ids=['MECH-180'], the only claim this run's implementation tests); EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE='evidence' correct (tests MECH-180 directly, matching 845); substrate API re-verified live against current ree_core source (run_sws_schema_pass, ContextMemory.write/memory, enter_sws_mode, force_cycle/_run_cycle all re-read in full this session, not assumed from 845); phased training / seed threading / progress instrumentation / runner conformance / output contract / z_goal wiring (DEAD_Z_GOAL_STREAM_EXEMPT, verbatim precedent from 845/718a/798a) all inherited unchanged and re-checked; new touched-slot statistic guards n_touched<2 per cycle (excluded from the per-cell mean rather than defaulting to a write-count-correlated 0.0) and is recorded with n_touched/insufficient-cycle diagnostics for auditability. DV-symmetry (604c) declared in script docstring for the new statistic: touched-slot SET and CONTENT both depend on real sampled buffer indices via the scaled step count and shrinking sample stride, not a scalar offset/monotone-rescale/permutation of the manipulation.

validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind (incl. 0 dead-z_goal-stream-warning -- exemption constant recognized; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog). Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed x 3-arm subset NONE_ON/HIGH_ON/HIGH_OFF): all 3 cells complete, verdict PASS x3, manifest+sentinel written, dry-run-relocated with 0 evidence/ leak (confirmed no _861 files remained under evidence/experiments/ post-run). New statistic computed sensibly and cleanly distinct from the legacy one (e.g. mean_sws_new_slot_diversity ~0.032 vs mean_sws_slot_diversity_wholebank_legacy ~0.56-0.62 on the same cells), n_touched_slots_per_cycle 4-5 (0 insufficient-touched-slot cycles). readiness_frac=0.00 on the smoke dose is EXPECTED (matches 845's own dry-run note): the 3-arm smoke subset omits 2 of the 4 required ON_ECO_ARMS, so _seed_readiness's len-check fails by construction, not by threshold. validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps on the smoke manifest.

items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, config fix + pre-flight smoke gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-475b)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-475b in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 475b FAILed at precondition P2 (dACC engagement): 0/6 seed-x-arm cells showed any dACC firing (n_dacc_fires=0 throughout, confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-475b_2026-08-01.md). P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3.  (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked against the script -- claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a claim-neutral diagnostic; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE ="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (9 preconditions C1a-h all readiness-kind with measured/threshold/met, load_bearing C2 criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for all 9); substrate API correctness (f_weight, _last_traj_components["f"]/["f_weighted"], and the "lateral_pfc" route branch independently grepped live in ree_core before writing); phased training (P0/P1/ P2 unchanged from 851); sample-size integrity (same latch-clearing idiom as 851/791a -- last_score_diagnostics cleared before every select_action, C1g and the new C1h reads both gated on the SAME fresh-select check since _last_traj_components is populated in the same score_trajectory call); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=total_train_eps loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*rung = 12 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, stamp_recording_core via write_flat_manifest, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator per 852's pattern -- an improvement over 851, which leaves it NOT RECORDED); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through). One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant"). One deliberate deviation from 851: the within-class-representative-entropy SECONDARY negative control is dropped -- its framing ("rule bias is class-keyed, cannot move within-class selection") is specific to sweeping use_candidate_rule_field, which is now a matched constant here, not the swept variable; nothing in this leg's design spec depends on it.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here.
